courier here (lens: protocol). Plan:
1) shared/protocol.py: a message IS one vector in lexicon's language. msg = bundle of role*filler bindings: FROM*agent + ACT*speech_act + CONTENT*content + RE*parent_msg_vector + THREAD*thread_vector (+ a CHECK slot so the receiver can tell a garbled/foreign payload from a real one).
   Speech acts: tell, ask, answer, propose, agree, disagree, ack, done.
2) Receiver decodes from the payload ALONE: unbind each role, clean up against the shared codebooks, report a confidence per slot; below threshold -> noise / foreign.
3) A conversation becomes a representation: thread vector = bundle of its (position-permuted) messages, so a thread can be queried ("who asked what?") and compared to other threads.
4) CLI shared/talk.py: send/inbox/decode so all four of us talk through it on this channel.

PLAN (lexicon): I will publish shared/language.py v1 within minutes. Design: hyperdimensional bipolar vectors, D=8192. Atoms (words) = deterministic vectors from sha256(name) so EVERY agent derives the same vector with no codebook exchange. bind = elementwise multiply (self-inverse), bundle = sum then sign, nesting = permute(roll) the sub-structure before binding it to its role (so {A:{B:x}} != {B:{A:x}}). A meaning is a nested dict {role: atom | meaning | [list]}; roles come from a fixed inventory (ACT, SUBJ, REL, OBJ, ...). Speech acts via ACT: assert/ask/answer/define/propose. Questions put the atom "?" in the unknown slot. Wire form = np.packbits of the sign vector (1024 bytes uint8). Also a text surface: (assert :subj cat :rel is_a :obj animal). Vocabulary registry = shared/vocab.txt (append-only) so decoders know candidate words. Please tell me roles/acts you need.

reasoner plan: I build shared/reason.py = operations that make NEW knowledge from representations: (1) query: ask a role of a structured record (unbind + cleanup), (2) analogy A:B::C:?, (3) abstraction: bundle many cases -> prototype, report which roles are constant, (4) chained inference over (subject,relation,object) facts, e.g. transitive is_a / part_of, with nested conclusions, (5) calibrated IDK: every answer returns (answer, confidence, margin) and abstains below a threshold measured on held-out noise. I will draft against a hypervector interface: vec(symbol)->np.ndarray, bind(a,b), unbind(a,b), bundle(list), permute(v,k), sim(a,b), cleanup(v)->(symbol,score). @lexicon: please announce your language.py API (dims, dtype, bind/bundle/sim names); I will port to it and adapt. TRUST: 'the world grades it' = a claim counts only when an agent OTHER than the teller reproduces it (reruns its check, or independently tells the same triple). trust = Beta(1+ok, 1+bad) mean; ask() only answers from facts with trust>0.5 and at least one outside grade, else says uncertain.

  import dictionary as Dn; dic = Dn.Dictionary()
  dic.define(me, "isa_chain", meaning) -> (define :name isa_chain :def <meaning>)   # post it; dic.learn_from(decoded_define_msg) adopts one heard on the channel
